title: Pokémon Center Mega Tokyo Plans to Reopen in September After March Stabbing Incident
content: ANN's staff confirmed that the Pokémon Center Mega Tokyo has had security guards stationed around the venue since March 27. Other Pokémon Centers (which have remain opened) have stationed security guards, particularly in their register area.
author: ANN

title: Re:ZERO Season 4 Takes Dominating Fifth Win in Week 8 of Spring 2026
content: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 4 has topped the weekly Spring 2026 anime rankings for the fifth time after its latest episode. The anime had over 20.08% of the total votes this time, which is the highest total tally so far in the season.
author: Anime Corner

title: Deadline: Hotaru's Way Gets U.S. Live-Action Series from Unapologetic Projects
content: Deadline wrote a summary: Hotaru is a polished executive assistant who spends her days in red bottoms and blazers and her nights in dirty sweats, eating takeout and binging reality TV in the apartment she sublets from her former boss, per the logline.
author: ANN

title: Studio MAPPA’s Most Controversial Anime Returns
content: Studio MAPPA has become a heavy hitter in the anime industry, thanks to bringing to life some of the biggest anime franchises to life. Since first swinging open its doors in 2011, the production house has released the likes of Attack on Titan’s final season, Jujutsu Kaisen, Chainsaw Man , and Hell’s Paradise .
author: ComicBook

title: Inazuma Eleven Cross Game Launches for iOS, Android on June 9
content: Level 5 and Aiming announced at the Inazuma Eleven : Grand Strategy Showcase on Friday that the Inazuma Eleven : Cross game will launch for iOS and Android on June 9. title: Nickelodeon Animator Drops Out of A.I. Program Following Backlash
content: Jorge R. Gutierrez has made a big name for himself in the animation industry, working on projects such as El Tigre: The Adventures of Manny Rivera , Maya And The Three , and El Macho . In the future, the animator is planning to enter the world of Looney Tunes with a Speedy Gonzalez movie.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece TV Anime's Elbaph Arc Reveals Trailer, Cast for Knights of God
content: The official X/Twitter account for the One Piece anime revealed on Friday a video and the cast members for the Knights of God: The newly announced cast members are: • Sumire Uesaka as Gunko • Hiroki Yasumoto as Sommers • Shinnosuke Tachibana as Killingham Kenjirō Tsuda was previously confirmed to play Shamrock.
author: ANN

title: Dokodemo Young Champion Digital Manga Magazine Ends Publication
content: The editorial staff of Akita Shoten 's Dokodemo Young Champion digital manga magazine announced in the magazine's June issue (seen right) on Tuesday that the magazine will cease publication, and the June issue is the magazine's final issue.
author: ANN

title: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End’s Real World Event Brings Tears to Voice Actors’ Eyes
content: Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End has wasted little time in becoming one of the biggest new anime series on the market. The immortal elf’s anime adventures, forged by Studio Madhouse, have two seasons under its belt, with a third on the way as it skyrockets in popularity.
author: ComicBook

title: Manga UP! Global Adds Karino Takatsu's Owl Night Manga
content: Manga UP! Global launched in English on Friday Karino Takatsu 's Owl Night manga . The company describes the story: When 20-year-old college student Eichi Usaki makes up his mind to visit the nightlife district, he gets a mysterious solicitation!
author: ANN
